headlines.title: Russia’s jet-powered drones are turning Kyiv into a daytime war zone
headlines.summary: As Ukraine’s defenses struggle to keep up with Russia’s technological advances, its capital is fast becoming a frontline city.

headlines.title: Pope Leo leans into statesman role, urging peace in an era of renewed war
headlines.summary: Wrapping up a four-day trip to France, the pope praised the European Union for “tearing down walls.”

headlines.title: Men accused of U.K. air base plot freed on bail as officials probe any Iran links
headlines.summary: Britain has confronted dozens of lethal plots traced to Iran in recent years, but the release of the suspects could indicate they were not seen as an imminent threat.

headlines.title: Trump says U.S., Iran slated for indirect talks after he rejects latest proposal
headlines.summary: Hostile rhetoric on both sides underscored the difficulty of reaching a negotiated end to the war.

headlines.title: 5 arrested in U.K. near base used by U.S. on suspicion of planning terror act
headlines.summary: President Trump said U.S. and British authorities were working together on the investigation. He said he believed the suspects were “looking to do big damage.”

headlines.title: In an appeal to the American people, IRGC says US must stop ‘war crimes’
headlines.summary: In an appeal to the American people, IRGC spokesman calls Trump a 'big liar,' says US has no choice but to leave region.

headlines.title: Iran’s Araghchi meets Qatari mediators as US calls for nuclear talks
headlines.summary: Tehran awaits reply on Hormuz plan as a US official says there will be no deal unless nuclear issues are addressed.

headlines.title: Hungary lifts immunity of Prime Minister Magyar, two Orban-era ministers
headlines.summary: Hungary's Parliament lifts immunity of incumbent leader and two former ministers, clearing the way for criminal probes.

headlines.title: Africa’s space ambitions are moving from policy to practice

headlines.title: Anti-South Asian ‘hate speech’ on X surges by 240%, US report finds
headlines.summary: Researchers link the rise to immigration politics, economic anxiety and the growing visibility of South Asians in US.

headlines.title: OpenAI delays latest model over security concerns, as industry faces pressure
headlines.summary: OpenAI's decision to hold back the model, called GPT-6.1 Astra, comes amid a broader push within the industry to slow the development of increasingly autonomous systems until safety measures catch up.

headlines.title: Tennessee is set to execute a woman for the first time in 200 years
headlines.summary: One of the youngest women sent to death row is set to be executed in Tennessee. If carried out as scheduled Wednesday, it would be Tennessee's first execution of a woman in 200 years.

headlines.title: The Senate passes the Protect College Sports Act, but the bill's future is unclear
headlines.summary: The bill's supporters, which include the NCAA, say it will tame what they call a "Wild West" era of college sports as litigation chips away at long-held rules around eligibility, transfers and pay.

headlines.title: Prosecutors are reopening a Cornell fraternity rape case. Here's what we know
headlines.summary: New York prosecutors are reopening an investigation into an alleged rape case at Cornell University in 2024. The alleged victim recently filed a lawsuit against seven members of Chi Phi fraternity.

headlines.title: Trump's immigration push has largely spared farms. Idaho dairymen worry it won't last.
headlines.summary: America's farms have largely escaped the president's aggressive immigration crackdown. But as ICE sweeps continue across the nation, farmers are uneasy because many still can't find enough workers.

headlines.title: Landmark Chinese garden takes root in England
headlines.summary: SALFORD, England — After nearly eight years in the making, a Chinese garden that authorities describe as the largest of its kind in Europe has opened in Salford, bringing a distinctive Chinese presence to the horticultural landscape of northern England.

headlines.title: Ukraine's provocations fuel tensions, Putin says
headlines.summary: MOSCOW/KYIV — Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Friday that an escalation of tensions would not achieve the outcome sought by Kyiv and could only worsen the situation in Ukraine.

headlines.title: Torrential rainfall keeps Thailand on flood alert
headlines.summary: Thailand's flood situation remained serious on Monday despite signs of easing rainfall in Bangkok, with authorities maintaining warnings across 30 provinces and ordering an emergency evacuation in Rayong Province after a reservoir was reported to be at risk of failure.

headlines.title: Roaring back to life
headlines.summary: A dinosaur statue stands guard outside a temple, a hint at the ancient giants buried deep in the earth below, making up northeastern Thailand's "dinosaur rush".

headlines.title: Outlook for stability upbeat after summit
headlines.summary: The high-stakes summit between President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump has provided an important framework for managing differences between the world's two largest economies and sent a reassuring message to the Asia-Pacific and the Middle East that the two major countries can promote global stability, analysts say.

headlines.summary: AAP donations drop to ₹12.10 crore in 2025-26, dominated by Prudent Electoral Trust and Trident Limited amid shifting political loyalties.
